findings.reason: the remedy and its done-when (`rg CODE_EXAMPLE_ID … matches only the helper`) rest on a mechanism that does not exist, so the section must instead name how a `range: CodeExample` slot stops producing the CODE_EXAMPLE_ID relationship (e.g. teach gen_schema_context to skip an inverse-named slot) or accept WIKI_PAGE_ID as the same defect it is fixing.
findings.text: §19 says `CodeChunk.code_example_id` should be "annotated the way the WikiChunk page slot already is (a relationship_type: HAS_CHUNK annotation naming the inverse direction)", but no such precedent exists: `WikiChunk.wiki_page_id` has no annotation, `gen_schema_context.py:143` emits `rel.cypher_type` (annotation or `slot_name.upper()`), so the wiki slot emits the phantom `('WikiChunk','WIKI_PAGE_ID','WikiPage','one')` at schema_context_data.py:2278; and if the annotation were added as described, `create_nodes` (imas_codex/graph/client.py:682) would declare and materialise `(CodeChunk)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(CodeExample)` — the reverse of the writer's edge — so the section would introduce a second reversed HAS_CHUNK declaration, not reconcile to the one edge the writer creates

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §19 hides the chunk→source join, the `HAS_CHUNK` traversal and the `source_file` coalesce behind one parameterised function in imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py, embedded by all five readers rather than re-rendered at each.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — §19 names the one HAS_CHUNK writer and adds no second link pass; §14 extends the reprocessability owner `PATH_RESET_SPECS` (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:240) rather than forking it, and its second clear site (the `--root` seed) is a distinct root-scoped entry point the section explains.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §14 extends the existing `discover paths --root` option (imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:21) with no new surface and §19 states "Interface budget: nothing added".
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §19 cites the "WikiChunk page slot" as an existing `relationship_type: HAS_CHUNK` annotation to imitate, but `WikiChunk.wiki_page_id` (imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:3790) carries no annotation and the generator emits WIKI_PAGE_ID (imas_codex/graph/schema_context_data.py:2278), the very same kind of phantom the section removes for CODE_EXAMPLE_ID.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the resolver replaces five divergent inline fragments and §19 states why the edge's single writer (imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:522, `MERGE (e)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(c)`) keeps the write instead of a new pass.
